IFB INDUSTRIES Q1 CONCALL: TARGETS 20% FY27 REVENUE GROWTH; ₹110 CR CAPEX PLANNED 🏭📈

• 🎯 Management working towards ~20% revenue growth in FY27, supported by strong Home Appliances momentum

• 🏠 Home Appliances revenue grew 18% in Q1, with July also starting strongly

• ⚠️ Margins remain under pressure from commodity costs & forex headwinds

• 💰 Higher revenue, operating leverage and ongoing cost-saving initiatives expected to support margin recovery

• 🏭 FY27 capex planned at around ₹110 Cr

• ⚙️ Engineering division has a larger ~₹400 Cr stamping capacity expansion plan, to be deployed as new business is secured

• 🚀 New Home Appliance products expected over the next 3–6 months, alongside stronger distribution and in-store presence

ASHOK LEYLAND Q1 CONCALL: CV DEMAND OUTLOOK STRONG; Q2 MARGINS FACE COMMODITY PRESSURE 🚛📈

• 🚚 Management expects MHCV industry to grow high single digits in FY27, with LCV growth expected to be slightly better

• 📈 Q2 demand expected to be stronger than Q1, with positive momentum seen in July & August

• ⚠️ Q2 margins could remain under pressure due to peak commodity prices

• 💰 Price hikes, cost savings and better product mix being used to offset commodity inflation

• 📉 Commodity prices expected to soften from Q3 FY27, providing margin relief

• 👥 Manpower costs expected to rise 4–5% from Q2, while management targets tighter control over other overheads

• ⚙️ Upcoming regulations including mandatory AC and advanced braking could increase vehicle costs, but management expects positive TCO benefits for customers

TITAGARH RAIL SYSTEMS Q1 CONCALL: TARGETS 200+ PASSENGER COACHES IN FY27; MAJOR CAPACITY RAMP-UP AHEAD 🚆📈

• 🚆 Maintains FY27 production guidance of 200+ passenger coaches, with quarterly production targeted at 45–50 coaches

• 🏭 Building capacity to manufacture 850 passenger coaches annually by FY29-30

• 💰 Passenger coach capacity represents potential annual revenue of around ₹8,500 Cr

• 🚛 Freight wagon capacity of 12,000 wagons/year represents potential revenue of ₹4,000–4,500 Cr

• 📑 Management optimistic about a large new Indian Railways wagon tender, although timing remains uncertain

• 🚇 Passenger rail outlook remains strong, supported by plans to expand metro coverage from 25 to 50 cities

• 📈 Government's target to increase freight loading to 3 billion tonnes expected to drive long-term wagon demand

SAATVIK GREEN ENERGY Q1 CONCALL: TARGETS ~₹6,000 CR FY27 REVENUE; FY28 SEEN AS “MILESTONE YEAR” ☀️📈

• 🎯 FY27 sales guidance maintained at 3.5–4 GW, translating into revenue of around ₹6,000 Cr

• 💰 FY27 EBITDA margin guided at ~12%, with PAT margin at 6–7%

• 🚀 Management expects FY28 to be a “milestone year”, driven by a sharp pickup in DCR panel demand from large utility-scale projects

• ☀️ DCR demand expected to accelerate from April 2027, supplementing retail, C&I and PM-KUSUM demand

• 🏭 Pursuing backward integration into solar cells, ingots & wafers

• ⚡ Plans to expand into ancillary products including transformers & inverters, evolving into an integrated energy platform

• 📊 Strategy aims to increase Saatvik’s value contribution in a solar project from ~25% currently to 40–50%

NATCO PHARMA Q1 CONCALL: MAINTAINS ₹1,050 CR FY27 PAT GUIDANCE 💊📈

• 🎯 Management reiterates FY27 PAT guidance of ₹1,050 Cr, despite strong Q1 contribution from Adcock Ingram

• 🌍 Adcock Ingram business is seasonal, prompting management to retain rather than upgrade full-year guidance

• 💰 India effective tax rate expected at around 27% following migration to the new tax regime

• 📊 Consolidated tax rate could fluctuate depending on the geographic mix of profits

• ⚠️ Q1 tax rate was elevated due to higher profit contribution from a jurisdiction with 35%+ tax rate

• 🏭 Maintains annual organic capex run-rate of ₹250–300 Cr for routine maintenance and upgrades

ZAGGLE Q1 CONCALL: MAINTAINS 40% FY27 REVENUE GROWTH; MARGINS SEEN IMPROVING 🚀📈

• 🎯 Maintains 40% consolidated revenue growth guidance for FY27, with growth expected to accelerate in coming quarters

• 📊 Standalone business expected to grow around 25% in FY27

• 💰 EBITDA margin expected to improve from 8.2% in Q1, supported by revenue contribution from DICE starting Q2

• 🚀 Long-term EBITDA margin target maintained at 14–15% over the next 5–7 years

• 🤖 FY27 focus on acquisition integration, improving core-business cash flows and AI-led enterprise solutions

• 🤝 M&A strategy to remain selective, targeting value-accretive domestic & international opportunities using QIP proceeds

• 🇦🇪 Plans to establish an ADGM, Abu Dhabi subsidiary in Q2 FY27 and enter the UAE with Save, Zoyer & Propel

POWER GRID Q1 CONCALL: MAINTAINS ₹37,000 CR CAPEX; ₹1.75 LAKH CR WORKS IN HAND ⚡📈

• 💰 Maintains FY27 capex guidance of ₹37,000 Cr and capitalization target of ₹30,000 Cr

• 🏗️ Q1 capitalization stood at ₹5,277 Cr, supporting confidence in achieving full-year guidance

• 📚 Works in hand at ₹1.75 lakh Cr — including ₹1.46 lakh Cr TBCB and ~₹25,000 Cr RTM projects

• 🚀 Near-term opportunity pipeline at ₹1.19 lakh Cr, including ₹73,875 Cr currently under bidding

• ⚡ Long-term transmission investment opportunity estimated at ₹15 lakh Cr+

• 🌱 Government's 900+ GW non-fossil capacity target by 2035-36 could require ~₹7.9 lakh Cr transmission investment

• 💧 Northeast hydro development represents another ~₹6.4 lakh Cr transmission opportunity

• 🖥️ Data centres and green hydrogen/ammonia expected to emerge as major new power-demand drivers

• 🌏 Exploring international grid connectivity with Sri Lanka & Myanmar under the One Sun, One World, One Grid initiative

RUBICON RESEARCH Q1 CONCALL: RAISES FY27 EBITDA MARGIN GUIDANCE TO 23% 💊📈

• 🚀 Management sees strong revenue traction, with Q2 FY27 tracking well for sequential USD revenue growth

• 💰 FY27 EBITDA margin guidance raised to 23% from earlier 22–23% range

• ⚠️ Margin guidance factors in ESOP costs, Arena growth investments and pre-revenue costs for upcoming facilities

• 💵 Working capital days improved to 114 from 126 QoQ; full-year guidance maintained at 125–130 days

• 🔬 Plans ₹500 Cr R&D spend over 9 quarters through Q1 FY28; ₹251 Cr already invested in the first 5 quarters

• 🏭 Pithampur facility expected to ramp up from Q1 CY27

• 🇺🇸 Newly acquired New Jersey facility targeted for commercialization during CY27

VOLTAS Q1 CONCALL: FOCUS ON RAC LEADERSHIP, PREMIUMISATION & SELECTIVE PROJECT GROWTH ❄️📈

• 🏆 Focus remains on consolidating RAC market leadership through innovation, premiumisation and deeper channel penetration

• 🏢 Commercial air conditioning seen as a significant long-term growth opportunity

• 🧊 Voltbek expected to maintain growth momentum through product segmentation, premiumisation and channel expansion, while progressively improving financials

• 🏗️ Projects business to pursue selective, value-accretive & fast-track orders, particularly in manufacturing and data centres

• 📦 Channel inventory currently at around 4 weeks, with dealers maintaining a cautious stance

• 🎉 Festive demand outlook should become clearer over the next 4–6 weeks, particularly for home appliances

• ⚠️ Q2 remains a seasonally lean quarter for cooling products, while geopolitical uncertainty remains a near-term monitorable

CHOLAMANDALAM FINANCIAL HOLDINGS Q1 CONCALL: FOCUS ON PROFITABLE GROWTH & PRICING DISCIPLINE 🛡️📈

• ⚠️ Near-term insurance environment remains competitive, with pricing pressure across Motor OD, Health & Commercial Fire

• 🌧️ Recent natural catastrophe events caused estimated ₹3,000–4,000 Cr industry losses, which management expects could restore pricing discipline in property insurance

• 🎯 Focus remains on disciplined underwriting, profitable growth and efficient claims management

• 🏢 Commercial lines including liability, credit & cyber insurance expected to be key future growth areas

• 🏥 Health insurance strategy focused on building a sustainable and profitable book rather than chasing aggressive growth

• 💻 New motor issuance platform for banks fully rolled out; motor claims workflows being upgraded for better efficiency

• 📋 Preparing for implementation of India’s Risk-Based Capital (RBC) and DPDP regulations

BRIGADE ENTERPRISES Q1 CONCALL: MAINTAINS ₹9,000 CR FY27 PRE-SALES GUIDANCE 🏗️📈

• 🎯 Reiterates ₹9,000 Cr pre-sales guidance for FY27, backed by a strong launch pipeline

• 🏘️ Plans to launch 9.36 Mn sq ft over the remaining 3 quarters of FY27; ~2.36 Mn sq ft targeted in Q2

• 🚀 Additional 3 Mn sq ft launch pipeline planned for Q1 FY28

• 💰 Real estate EBITDA margin reached 21% in Q1 and is expected to broadly sustain in the 20%+ range through FY27

• 🏢 Office leasing revenue expected to grow at ~20% CAGR over the next 5–6 years

• 🏨 Hospitality weakness from West Asia conflict seen as temporary; MICE & events expected to rebound strongly in H2

• 💵 Strong domestic demand expected to support healthy hotel ADRs

PHYSICSWALLAH Q1 CONCALL: MAINTAINS 30% FY27 REVENUE GROWTH; EBITDA SEEN DOUBLING 🎓📈

• 🚀 Reaffirms 30% revenue growth guidance for FY27

• 💰 Targets 100% improvement in EBITDA for the full year

• 🏫 Offline business expected to reach near-profitability by FY27-end

• 📱 Online margins expected to improve as newer categories such as NEET PG, Vernacular & Curious Junior move towards breakeven

• 🤖 Management exploring AI-first M&A opportunities, while continuing to strengthen online offerings

• 💵 Capital allocation to remain opportunistic, with no major unexpected strategic investments planned in the near term

ROYAL ORCHID HOTELS Q1 CONCALL: 50+ HOTELS IN PIPELINE; TARGETS 20%+ ROCE 🏨📈

• 🏗️ 50+ hotels already signed, expected to become operational over the next 18–24 months

• 🤝 Expansion largely through asset-light management & franchise contracts, limiting capital requirements

• 💰 Managed segment fee income expected to grow substantially as new hotels become operational

• 🏨 JLO segment growth to be driven by stabilisation and ramp-up of Iconica

• 🔑 Focus shifting towards larger 80–120 key hotels to improve average yield and premiumise the portfolio

• 🎯 Management targets 20%+ ROCE, potentially achievable over the next year or so

• ✈️ Strong domestic travel, improving infrastructure and healthy leisure & business demand remain key industry tailwinds

SKF INDIA (INDUSTRIAL) Q1 CONCALL: AIMS TO DOUBLE BUSINESS IN 5 YEARS 🏭📈

• 🚀 Management aspires to double the business over the next 5 years, supported by infrastructure, steel, cement, railways & renewable energy demand

• 💰 Near-term PBT margin guidance at 14–16%

• 🎯 Long-term ambition to achieve 17–19% PBT margins, with improvement expected post-2028

• 🏭 Plans ₹90–95 Cr investment in new Pune manufacturing plant to support future growth and localisation

• ⚠️ Pune plant investments expected to temper margins until 2028 before operating efficiencies and localisation benefits kick in

• 📊 Current underlying margin, adjusted for one-off costs, is around 12%

• 🔄 Demerger expected to enable sharper capital allocation and strategic focus

ZOTA HEALTH CARE Q1 CONCALL: TARGETS EBITDA POSITIVE FROM Q2; CASH BREAK-EVEN BY Q4 FY27/Q1 FY28 💊📈

• 🏪 Targets 600–650 new stores in FY27; already added 200+ stores in Q1

• 🎯 Store additions to moderate in Q2–Q3 as focus shifts towards improving store productivity & operational efficiency

• 💰 Management expects reported EBITDA to turn positive from Q2 FY27 onwards

• 📈 Full-year FY27 EBITDA margin expected to be higher than FY26

• ⚖️ Targets cash break-even by Q4 FY27 or Q1 FY28

• 📢 FY27 marketing budget estimated at ₹40–45 Cr; Q1 spend was elevated due to one-time brand ambassador and commercial production costs

• 🚀 Focus remains on sustainable store expansion, stronger brand awareness and improving unit economics

VEEFIN SOLUTIONS Q1 CONCALL : FOCUS SHIFTS TO EXECUTION & MONETISATION 🚀📈

• 🎯 FY27 focus on converting strong sales pipeline, multi-product wins and cross-selling to 50+ existing clients

• 🏦 PSB Xchange: 7 lenders currently under integration; targeting 10–12 live lenders to reach an inflection point and accelerate transaction throughput

• 🔄 Management expects amalgamation to complete within the next 1–2 quarters, simplifying the listed entity structure before FY27-end

• 📊 Management suggests tracking growth through annual cohorts of enterprise deal wins rather than QoQ due to revenue-recognition cycles

• 🚀 Q1 FY27 base performance already running at a higher level than FY26 quarterly average

• 💰 Strong pipeline and operating leverage expected to support improving financial performance; no specific numerical guidance provided

TURTLEMINT Q1 CONCALL: TARGETS FULL-YEAR PROFITABILITY IN FY27; 40%+ GROWTH TRAJECTORY 🚀📈

• 💰 After achieving adjusted EBITDA breakeven in Q4 FY26, management expects consolidated profitability for full FY27

• 📈 Profitability expected to improve by 40%+, in line with historical trends

• 🎯 Targets 18–20% PAT margin by FY30, supported by service EBITDA margins expanding to 24–25% from ~13%

• 🚀 Expects to maintain its historical 40%+ growth trajectory, driven by more active digital partners and higher productivity

• 🔄 Growing renewal book expected to remain a major driver of growth and profitability

• 🌐 Focus on deeper penetration in B30 markets, technology & AI-led efficiencies and expanding into non-insurance products

GLOBAL SURFACES Q1: MANAGEMENT SAYS “WORST IS OVER”; INDIA LAUNCH FROM Q2 FY27 📈

• 🇮🇳 Plans to launch products in the Indian domestic market in Q2 FY27, expected to become a meaningful revenue contributor over coming years

• 🏭 Capacity utilisation currently at ~27%, with improvement expected as geopolitical conditions normalise and order book execution picks up

• 🌍 Diversifying exports beyond the US, targeting Europe and additional GCC markets

• 💰 Cost-reduction initiatives and geographic diversification expected to support recovery

• 📦 Management highlighted a strong order book, supporting future utilisation improvement

• ⚠️ No specific FY27 revenue or volume guidance due to geopolitical and trade uncertainties

SAMMAAN CAPITAL Q1: AGGRESSIVE GROWTH & DISTRIBUTION EXPANSION 🚀🏦

• 💰 Disbursed ₹3,875 Cr in Q1 FY27 across 5 products to ~12,000 new customers

• 📉 Cost of funds improved to 10.0% from 10.4% in Q4 FY26; targets ~9.3% in FY27 and ~7.8% by FY30

• 🎯 Targets AAA rating by FY28, supported by operating strength and IHC Group backing

• 📱 H2 FY27 expansion into digital personal loans, micro-LAP & rural home loans; Gold, 2W/3W and retail e-commerce lending planned from FY28

• 🏦 Branch network targeted to rise from 217 in FY26 → 270 FY27 → ~1,605 by FY30, including ~1,000 Gold Loan branches

• 👥 Plans ~3x workforce expansion to strengthen sales, credit and collections

• 📈 Will pursue both organic & inorganic growth opportunities

STERLITE TECHNOLOGIES: WINS ₹8.56 CR DoT ARBITRATION CASE ⚖️✅

• ⚖️ Dispute related to a ₹8.56 Cr demand notice issued by Department of Telecommunications (DoT) in 2020

• ✅ Arbitration tribunal had ruled in favour of Sterlite Technologies in May 2023

• 🏛️ DoT challenged the award before the Delhi High Court under Section 34 of the Arbitration Act

• 📜 Delhi High Court has dismissed DoT's petition, thereby upholding the arbitration award in STL's favour

• 💰 Company states the matter has no financial or operational exposure

🟢 Impact: Positive – Legal dispute resolved in STL's favour with no financial exposure.

REMSONS IND Q1 : STRONG GLOBAL OEM ORDER WINS & EXPANSION 🚗📈

• 🌟 Secured ₹300 Cr, 7-year order from Stellantis for control cables

• 🚚 UK subsidiary nominated for 10-year Pedal Box programme worth ~₹160 Cr

• ⚙️ Won ₹60 Cr Gear Shifter order from leading Indian CV OEM

• 💡 Secured ₹12 Cr exterior vehicle lighting design order from global OEM

• 🎯 Targets ₹900–1,000 Cr revenue by FY30, implying 24–29% CAGR

• 🏭 Plans ₹100 Cr capex over 3 years for plant upgrades & EV-compatible parts; added 20,000 sq ft property in NCR

• 🌍 China+1, exports and premiumisation across sensors, lighting & locomotives to drive growth

• 🔍 Exploring selective M&A; expanding manufacturing footprint across India, UK & Brazil

RITCO LOGISTICS Q1 : RECORD QUARTER WITH STRONG BUSINESS TRACTION 🚛📈

• 📈 Turnover increased YoY, but declined slightly QoQ due to Middle East conflict impact

• 🚚 Secured a long-term transportation contract in the petrochemical sector

• 🏗️ Won multiple new contracts across Steel & Building Materials

• 🚛 Secured a sizeable fly-ash transportation mandate from a leading infrastructure player

• 📊 EBITDA increased QoQ but declined YoY due to ₹6.04 Cr rise in employee costs, mainly from scaling TrucksUp

• 📉 PAT declined YoY & QoQ due to higher depreciation and employee costs

• ⭐ Maintained CRISIL A- credit rating

• 💰 Plans to raise funds in TrucksUp to accelerate growth without impacting Ritco's cash flow

RITCO LOGISTICS Q1 FY27: BUSINESS MOMENTUM STRONG, PROFITABILITY UNDER PRESSURE

• 📈 Turnover increased YoY, though declined slightly QoQ due to the ongoing Middle East conflict

• 🚚 Secured a long-term petrochemical transportation contract covering complex multi-location movements

• 🏗️ Won multiple new contracts in Steel & Building Materials and a sizeable fly-ash logistics mandate

• 💰 EBITDA improved QoQ but declined YoY as employee costs increased by ₹6.04 Cr, largely due to scaling of TrucksUp

• 📉 PAT declined both YoY & QoQ due to higher depreciation and employee expenses

• ⭐ Maintained CRISIL A- credit rating despite geopolitical and logistics-sector challenges

• 💵 Plans to raise funds in TrucksUp to accelerate growth without impacting Ritco's cash flows

JUNIPER GREEN ENERGY WINS 230 MW SECI FDRE PROJECT ⚡

• 🏆 Received Letter of Award from SECI for 230 MW Firm & Dispatchable Renewable Energy (FDRE-RTC) project

• 💰 Tariff fixed at ₹5.26/unit

• 🔌 Project will be connected to the Inter-State Transmission System (ISTS)

• 🏗️ Scope includes construction, commissioning & operation of the 230 MW project

• 📅 Project to be commissioned within 24 months from effective date of PPA

• 🤝 PPA tenure: 25 years from commercial operation date

🟢 Impact: Positive – Large 230 MW long-term SECI project strengthens Juniper Green Energy’s contracted renewable portfolio and revenue visibility.

HAZOOR MULTI PROJECTS WINS NHAI ORDER 🚧

• 🏆 Received Letter of Award from NHAI for user-fee collection on NH-31 in Jharkhand

• 💰 Order value: ₹28.47 Cr

• 🛣️ Project covers Km 0.000 to Km 27.500 with fee collection at Madan Gopalpur Fee Plaza

• 🔧 Includes operation & maintenance of adjacent toilet blocks and replenishment of consumable items

• 📅 Contract period: 1 year

🟢 Impact: Positive – New NHAI order strengthens the company’s infrastructure operations portfolio.

RAJESH POWER SERVICES EXPANDS INTO NEW ZEALAND 🇳🇿

• 🌏 Incorporated Rajesh Power Services NZ Limited as a 100% wholly owned foreign subsidiary

• ⚡ New entity will operate in Power Transmission & Distribution

• ☀️ Business focus includes Electrical & Solar EPC and power transmission & distribution projects

• 💰 Investment will be through cash subscription to share capital

• 📅 Subsidiary incorporated in New Zealand on August 14, 2026

🟢 Impact: Positive – Overseas subsidiary opens opportunities for international expansion in power and renewable-energy EPC.

TD Power Systems Limited ("TDPS") has entered
into a Build-to-Print Manufacturing Framework Agreement dated August 13, 2026 with Siemens
Energy, Inc. ("Siemens Energy"), pursuant to which TDPS will manufacture and supply 2-pole
Generators in accordance with Siemens Energy's designs, drawings and specifications.

In simple words

TD Power has signed a 10 year deal with Siemens Energy's US arm to build large 2-pole generators for Siemens.

Siemens gives the designs and drawings, TDPS manufactures them. Siemens is doing this because its own factories are full (the AI data-centre power boom has its order books stuffed for years), so it needs someone qualified to make machines on its behalf. 

TDPS has licensed Siemens' 2-pole technology for over a decade, so this is that relationship getting upgraded from "we borrow your design" to "we are your factory."

Business only comes through individual purchase orders whenever Siemens issues them. So nothing goes into the order book today, and since these machines take 18–20 months to build, real revenue starts showing up around FY29. 

Also, since TDPS is building to Siemens' design and not its own, it doesn't own the technology and likely earns a thinner margin per unit  but with far higher volume, less design risk and better factory utilisation. 

Think of it as TDPS becoming a "CDMO for generators" for one of the world's top three turbine makers: strategically a very strong position, but for now it's a licence to receive orders, not the orders themselves.

Reliance Industries and Rolls-Royce announce strategic intent to partner and develop India's indigenous combat engine for the Advanced Medium Combat Aircraft (AMCA) programme

London / Mumbai, 14thAugust 2026: Reliance Industries Limited (Reliance) and Rolls-Royce (LSE: RR., ADR: RYCEY) today announced their strategic intent to partner and offer capabilities for the design, development, manufacturing and delivery of a sovereign indigenous combat engine for India’s Advanced Medium Combat Aircraft (AMCA) programme.

As part of the partnership, Reliance and Rolls-Royce will explore the formation of a dedicated Aerospace Gas Turbine Complex that will be a centre of excellence for power and propulsion technology in India.

The partnership will offer a compelling proposition for joint development of the AMCA engine in India, bringing together world-leading technology and industrial execution capabilities. This marks a step towards realising the vision set out by the Hon’ble Prime Minister of India, Shri Narendra Modi, for India’s defence ecosystem to deliver an indigenous engine to power the country’s fighter jet programme.

text:
Sansera builds precision metal parts for cars, planes, and chip-making machines. Its aerospace and semiconductor order book jumped to Rs 5750 crore from Rs 4464 crore in 3 months, after winning Rs 1250 crore deal from single semiconductor equipment maker. 

That customer builds machines used inside chip factories. Global spending on such machines crossed $143B in 2026 because AI needs more chips than factories can produce. 

Sansera machines complex metal chambers these factories require. Revenue from this deal starts in 2027 and peaks in 2029. >>

Non-auto sales more than doubled. EBITDA margin improved to 19.2% from 17.2%, means company kept more of each rupee earned. 

Aerospace and semiconductor work brought in Rs 315 crore last year and targets Rs 550-600 crore this year. Company appointed separate CEO just for this segment, treating it as independent operation. 

This work earns 25-30% margins versus 19% company average. As it grows, blended profitability rises without needing price hikes.

They can now machine turbine blisks and single-crystal metal parts, skills very few companies globally have. Blisks are rotating discs with blades attached, used inside jet engines. 

Making them requires cutting titanium or nickel alloys to extreme precision. Single-crystal parts are harder because metal has no grain boundaries, so conventional cutting fails. 

These capabilities move Sansera from making seat brackets and cargo parts to engine-level aerospace components where margins and barriers run far higher. 

New hangar and facility under construction, targeting Rs 8000-9000 crore revenue by decade end.

Requires lending rates to be set per transparent structure linked to benchmark & a positive spread
